translated_title: Sheinbaum Doubles the Education Goal: Announces 400,000 New High School Places
original_title: Sheinbaum duplica la meta educativa: anuncia 400 mil nuevos lugares para educación media superior
author: Néstor Jiménez
meta_description: Only months after setting a 200,000 target in April, Sheinbaum doubled it to 400,000 new public high school places, expanding free public education under the Plan Oriente.
